title: chloris roxburghii
intro: Chloris roxburghii, commonly known as Swertia chirata or Kirgancha, is a type of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Chloris roxburghii are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
